en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a church with a tall, slender spire rising from an onion‑shaped dome atop a square tower. The church façade has narrow arched windows and simple plastered walls, with a gabled nave and a modest entrance partly obscured by trees. The street in front is unpaved and there is an early 20th‑century vehicle or shed structure at the left edge, suggesting a small European town setting. No printed caption or visible writing appears on the image side.
